chapter: 1977: Kansas City honor and the piano
title: Kansas City musicians still around; Mary Lou Williams at Duke
summary: Basie names a few local Kansas City musicians and learns Mary Lou Williams is teaching at Duke.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: Were there any Kansas City musicians who, you know, are not big names, but are still working there? Or were there any people you know, who wouldn't be famous, let's say.

They're kind of famous around that area. You know, like (inaudible), for many years, he was one of the top guys. Baby Lovett and oh, so many of them gone that was there, you know, but can't name too many now. That are there now. Of course, we weren't lucky enough to have Mary Lou there. Mary Lou Williams.
Great, then I'm going to see her Saturday.
I'll give you her number -- well, I'm sure you'll be in touch with her.
We're going to be in Duke Saturday.
She's teaching there and she's bought a house there, in Durham.
